column1: Study of the origins and distribution of human populations used to be based on archaeological and fossil evidence.
column2: 过去，对人群起源和分布的研究以考古证据和化石证据为依据。

column1: A number of techniques developed since the 1950s, however, have placed the study of these subjects on a sounder and more objective footing.
column2: 不过，20世纪50年代以来发展起来的一些技术，使这些问题的研究有了更可靠、更客观的基础。

column1: The best information on early population movements is now being obtained from the ‘archaeology of the living body’, the clues to be found in genetic material.
column2: 如今，要了解早期人群迁徙，最有价值的信息来自“活体考古”，也就是在遗传物质中找到的线索。
column3: early population movements|早期人群迁徙

column1: Recent work on the problem of when people first entered the Americas is an example of the value of these new techniques.
column2: 人类最初何时进入美洲？近期对这一问题的研究，便体现了这些新技术的价值。

column1: North-east Asia and Siberia have long been accepted as the launching ground for the first human colonisers of the New World.
column2: 长期以来，人们一直认为，首批前往新大陆定居的人类是从东北亚和西伯利亚出发的。
column5: have long been accepted as|长期以来一直被公认为
column7: colonisers|n. 最早前往定居的人

column1: But was there one major wave of migration across the Bering Strait into the Americas, or several?
column2: 不过，当初跨越白令海峡进入美洲的大规模迁徙，究竟只有一波，还是有好几波？

column1: And when did this event, or events, take place?
column2: 这次迁徙，或是这几次迁徙，发生在什么时候？
column3: event|n. 事件，此处指一次迁徙

column1: In recent years, new clues have come from research into genetics, including the distribution of genetic markers in modern Native Americans.
column2: 近年来，遗传学研究提供了新的线索，其中包括对当代美洲原住民遗传标记分布情况的研究。

column1: An important project, led by the biological anthropologist Robert Williams, focused on the variants (called Gm allotypes) of one particular protein – immunoglobin G – found in the fluid portion of human blood.
column2: 生物人类学家罗伯特·威廉斯主持了一项重要研究，重点考察一种特定蛋白质的变体（称为 Gm 同种异型）。这种蛋白质是免疫球蛋白G，存在于人体血液的液体成分中。

column1: All proteins ‘drift’, or produce variants, over the generations, and members of an interbreeding human population will share a set of such variants.
column2: 所有蛋白质在世代相传的过程中都会发生“漂变”，即产生变体。同一人群的成员相互通婚，因而会共有一组这样的变体。
column7: over the generations|在世代传递过程中
column8: interbreeding|adj. 成员之间相互繁衍的

column1: Thus, by comparing the Gm allotypes of two different populations (e.g. two Indian tribes), one can establish their genetic ‘distance’, which itself can be calibrated to give an indication of the length of time since these populations last interbred.
column2: 因此，比较两个不同人群（例如两个美洲原住民部族）的Gm同种异型，就能确定两者的遗传“距离”。这种距离本身还可以加以校准，用来估计距这两个人群上一次通婚已过去多久。
column11: give an indication of|大致表明

column1: Williams and his colleagues sampled the blood of over 5,000 American Indians in western North America during a twenty-year period.
column2: 在20年间，威廉斯和同事采集了北美西部5000多名美洲原住民的血样。

column1: They found that their Gm allotypes could be divided into two groups, one of which also corresponded to the genetic typing of Central and South American Indians.
column2: 他们发现，这些人的Gm同种异型可分为两组，其中一组也与中美洲和南美洲原住民的遗传分型相符。
column8: Central and South American Indians|中美洲和南美洲原住民

column1: Other tests showed that the Inuit (or Eskimo) and Aleut formed a third group.
column2: 其他检验表明，因纽特人（又称爱斯基摩人）和阿留申人构成了第三组。

column1: From this evidence it was deduced that there had been three major waves of migration across the Bering Strait.
column2: 根据这些证据，研究者推断，人群曾分三大波跨越白令海峡迁徙。
column5: major waves of migration|大规模迁徙浪潮

column1: The first, Paleo-Indian, wave more than 15,000 years ago was ancestral to all Central and South American Indians.
column2: 第一波迁徙发生在1.5万多年前。随这波迁徙而来的古印第安人，是所有中美洲和南美洲原住民的祖先。
column7: Central and South American Indians|中美洲和南美洲原住民

column1: The second wave, about 14,000-12,000 years ago, brought Na-Dene hunters, ancestors of the Navajo and Apache (who only migrated south from Canada about 600 or 700 years ago).
column2: 第二波迁徙约在1.4万至1.2万年前，带来了纳-德内猎人，也就是纳瓦霍人和阿帕奇人的祖先。（后面这两个族群直到约六七百年前才从加拿大向南迁徙。）

column1: The third wave, perhaps 10,000 or 9,000 years ago, saw the migration from North-east Asia of groups ancestral to the modern Eskimo and Aleut.
column2: 第三波迁徙可能发生在1万年前或9000年前。当时，一些人群从东北亚迁出，他们是今天的爱斯基摩人和阿留申人的祖先。

column1: How far does other research support these conclusions?
column2: 其他研究在多大程度上支持这些结论？

column1: Geneticist Douglas Wallace has studied mitochondrial DNA in blood samples from three widely separated Native American groups: Pima-Papago Indians in Arizona, Maya Indians on the Yucatán peninsula, Mexico, and Ticuna Indians in the Upper Amazon region of Brazil.
column2: 遗传学家道格拉斯·华莱士研究了三个相距很远的美洲原住民群体血样中的线粒体DNA。这三个群体是亚利桑那州的皮马-帕帕戈人、墨西哥尤卡坦半岛的玛雅人和巴西亚马孙河上游地区的提库纳人。
column7: Native American groups|美洲原住民群体
column8: Pima-Papago Indians|n. 皮马-帕帕戈人
column12: Upper Amazon region|亚马孙河上游地区

column1: As would have been predicted by Robert Williams’s work, all three groups appear to be descended from the same ancestral (Paleo-Indian) population.
column2: 正如从罗伯特·威廉斯的研究中可以预料的那样，这三个群体看来都源自同一个祖先人群，即古印第安人。

column1: There are two other kinds of research that have thrown some light on the origins of the Native American population; they involve the study of teeth and of languages.
column2: 另有两类研究为美洲原住民的起源提供了一些线索，分别研究牙齿和语言。
column4: thrown some light on|为……提供一些线索
column6: Native American population|美洲原住民群体

column1: The biological anthropologist Christy Turner is an expert in the analysis of changing physical characteristics in human teeth.
column2: 生物人类学家克里斯蒂·特纳专长于分析人类牙齿形态特征的变化。

column1: He argues that tooth crowns and roots have a high genetic component, minimally affected by environmental and other factors.
column2: 他认为，牙冠和牙根在很大程度上取决于遗传，受环境及其他因素的影响很小。

column1: Studies carried out by Turner of many thousands of New and Old World specimens, both ancient and modern, suggest that the majority of prehistoric Americans are linked to Northern Asian populations by crown and root traits such as incisor shoveling (a scooping out on one or both surfaces of the tooth), single-rooted upper first premolars and triple-rooted lower first molars.
column2: 特纳研究了新大陆和旧大陆数以千计的古代和现代标本。研究表明，大多数史前美洲人与北亚人群之间的联系，可从一些牙冠和牙根特征看出来，例如铲形门齿（牙齿的一面或两面呈凹陷状）、单根的上颌第一前磨牙和三根的下颌第一磨牙。
column5: New and Old World|新大陆和旧大陆
column14: crown and root traits|牙冠和牙根特征
column19: upper first premolars|上颌第一前磨牙
column21: lower first molars|下颌第一磨牙

column1: According to Turner, this ties in with the idea of a single Paleo-Indian migration out of North Asia, which he sets at before 14,000 years ago by calibrating rates of dental micro-evolution.
column2: 特纳认为，这与古印第安人曾从北亚向外迁徙一次的说法相吻合。他根据牙齿微进化速率进行校准，将这次迁徙定在距今1.4万年以前。

column1: Tooth analyses also suggest that there were two later migrations of Na-Denes and Eskimo- Aleut.
column2: 牙齿分析还表明，后来又发生过两次迁徙，涉及纳-德内人和爱斯基摩-阿留申人。

column1: The linguist Joseph Greenberg has, since the 1950s, argued that all Native American languages belong to a single ‘Amerind’ family, except for Na-Dene and Eskimo-Aleut - a view that gives credence to the idea of three main migrations.
column2: 自20世纪50年代以来，语言学家约瑟夫·格林伯格一直主张，除纳-德内语和爱斯基摩-阿留申语外，美洲原住民的所有语言都属于同一个“阿美林德”语系。这一观点让三次主要迁徙的说法更可信。

column1: Greenberg is in a minority among fellow linguists, most of whom favour the notion of a great many waves of migration to account for the more than 1,000 languages spoken at one time by American Indians.
column2: 格林伯格在语言学界属于少数派。多数同行认为，美洲原住民一度使用过1000多种语言，要解释这一点，需要用许多次迁徙来说明。
column5: most of whom|他们中的大多数

column1: But there is no doubt that the new genetic and dental evidence provides strong backing for Greenberg’s view.
column2: 不过，新的遗传学证据和牙齿研究证据，无疑为格林伯格的观点提供了有力支持。
column3: there is no doubt that|毫无疑问

column1: Dates given for the migrations should nevertheless be treated with caution, except where supported by hard archaeological evidence.
column2: 尽管如此，对这些迁徙的年代仍应持谨慎态度，除非有确凿的考古证据予以支持。
column9: hard archaeological evidence|确凿的考古证据
